title: Article
description: One article: its frontmatter's fields, and its text as body.

title.title: Title
title.description: The article's headline, as its page, the index and the feed print it.

date.title: Date
date.description: The day the article was published, as YYYY-MM-DD.

summary.title: Summary
summary.description: One or two sentences on what the article is about, shown in the index and the feed. Leaving it out shows the title alone.

tags.title: Tags
tags.description: Short topic words listed beneath the article's headline and as the feed entry's categories.

draft.title: Draft
draft.description: true keeps the article off the site: it gets no page and is in neither the index nor the feed.

body.title: Body
body.description: The article's text: the Markdown after the frontmatter, in the subset the meaning document describes.
